description: This PHP class represents an entity 'TaskSchedulerLog' in a Doctrine ORM setup. It maps to the 'ohrm_task_scheduler_log' database table and defines properties for logging the start time, finish time, command, input data, and status of scheduled tasks within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: TaskSchedulerLog
classes.description: Entity class representing a log entry for scheduled tasks, including timestamps, command details, input, and status.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the log entry.

methods.name: setStartedAt
methods.description: Sets the start time of the task.

methods.name: setFinishedAt
methods.description: Sets the finish time of the task.

methods.name: setCommand
methods.description: Sets the command associated with the log entry.

methods.name: setInput
methods.description: Sets the input data for the task.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the task.
